[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-as[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Rotten Log: a dated, reasoned history of every rotten keep[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every counted keep of a rotten task (Alt+F or Ctrl+Alt+F on an [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exact due Ready ROTTEN or scheduled TICKLER row, and Keep on the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]approved-decay card) asks "Why keep it as written?" and, in the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]same transaction as the stamp, writes one dated entry under a `🥀 [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]**ROTTEN LOG**` child. Each task then shows how many times, when, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and why it was kept: in the note, in the prompt, on the decay card,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]on the freshness mark tooltip, in note snapshots, and in the Mac [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agenda.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]glossary docs pages.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]project conversion carries the log and later phases share one grammar.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]single-target Alt+F and Ctrl+Alt+F (including the card-unavailable [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fallback) through them.[/#D7D7AF]
